## Run 78 · stage s3 — UI consistency audit complete

**1 defect found, 1 fixed. 9 candidates raised, 8 killed by verification.** Two commits, build passes, working tree clean, net zero DB writes.

### The defect: `/alerts` storm-alert toggles were completely invisible

`AlertSettings.jsx:330` drove both toggles through the third-party **`react-switch`**, passing the app's oklch tokens as `onColor`/`offColor`/`onHandleColor`. react-switch doesn't hand those to CSS — it *parses them itself* to interpolate the track colour during the flip animation. It can't read `oklch()`, so it emitted the track and handle with **no `background` property at all**:

```
style="height:24px; width:44px; … border-radius:12px; transition: background 0.25s;"
                                                      ↑ transitions a property it never sets
```

Both computed `rgba(0,0,0,0)`. ON was indistinguishable from OFF — on the only screen controlling whether storm alerts are sent. Screenshots confirm: label present, no control.

Fixed (`6740bb9`) by swapping in the toggle the app **already** uses in `SettingsView.jsx:1538` (the duplicate of this very panel) and `OnboardingPage.jsx:729` — same 44×24/12px/18px geometry, `--accent-green`, `role="switch"`+`aria-checked` preserved, `aria-label` added. Both panels now render an identical control; config value toggled off and back on, unchanged.

### The reusable lesson

An oklch colour only breaks a third-party component that **parses** it to compute with it. Pass-through-to-CSS/SVG is fine. Verified rather than assumed — all three "fine" cases would otherwise have been filed as bugs:

| | |
|---|---|
| **BREAKS** | `react-switch` — interpolates the track colour |
| FINE | recharts (`stroke="oklch(…)"` → SVG attribute) |
| FINE | Stripe Elements — **mount-tested**, two live CardElements side by side (oklch vs hex): both mounted, no throw, visually identical |
| FINE | mapbox/Google — already fed hex |

### Audits 1–7, measured on all 19 routes
Icons **0 non-conforming (5th clean run)** · **zero native `<select>`/date inputs (7th consecutive)** · TopBar 56px + exactly one `<h1>` on all 19 · sidebar uniform · 0 overflow · **all 4 modals compute `modal-scale-in`** (Run 75's fix holds). Button/spacing/modal variance all landed on already-documented developer decisions.

### Worth flagging
- **Two of the 8 kills were my own harness bugs**, both now written to standing gotchas: a `data-*` set difference missed `el.dataset.init =` imperative writes, and stripping `{expr}` blocks deleted every dynamic button label (4 bogus "unnamed control" hits).
- The finding did **not** come from a set difference — all three new kinds (icon-vs-action semantics, `data-*` set-vs-queried, unnamed icon controls) were clean. That vein is dry two stages running; this one came from grouping computed styles and investigating the transparent bucket.
- `react-switch` is now unimported but still in `client/package.json` — removal is your call, not QA's.
- **The s2 fuzz residue is still uncleaned — 6th stage carrying it.** s4 needs to run the scoped cleanup.

Report at `tests/audit-reports/ui-audit-2026-08-17-run78-s3.txt` (copied to `C:\tmp\ui-audit-results.txt`); resume memory and standing gotchas updated.
